name: Frame studio
description: Make a Magic Set Editor frame from pictures: the blank frames a proxy maker shares or sells (one per colour, also Photoshop files – each colour put together from its layers), or your own. Fonts that come with it are installed for MSE. Drag where the name, mana cost, art, type line, rules text and P/T go, pick the text colours and fonts, and add it to MSE – your cards can use it like any other frame.
author: MEZTKING

page.title: Frame studio
page.tooltip: Make an MSE frame from a proxy maker's blank frames or your own pictures
